workflows.title: Core
workflows.summary: Groups, memlock, model store, and validate. Always applied.
workflows.notes: Does not install a desktop or a model.

workflows.title: Chat
workflows.summary: llama.cpp for GGUF. Hugging Face safetensors directories go in ~/Models/hf.
workflows.notes: llama-server loads GGUF. Safetensors chat checkpoints are stored as Hugging Face directories under hf/ for vLLM, ComfyUI, and converters. The user unit stays disabled until a model is set.

workflows.title: NPU + iGPU hybrid
workflows.summary: Wire FastFlowLM on XDNA2 next to llama.cpp Vulkan on the iGPU.
workflows.notes: FastFlowLM is not in the Ubuntu archive. The installer detects flm and XRT if present. It will not add AMD PPAs in v1. NPU firmware is validated, not rewritten.

workflows.title: TTS: OpenMOSS
workflows.summary: Installs moss-tts-server and the local GGUF pair (about 8.5 GiB) if they are not already on disk.
workflows.notes: Pinned pwilkin/openmoss v0.3.0 Vulkan Linux archive into ~/.local. Reuses matching GGUFs from scan folders before downloading.

workflows.title: TTS: RHVoice
workflows.summary: Parametric neural TTS from Ubuntu. Runs after apt with no extra downloads.
workflows.notes: Best TTS that installs from the archive. RHVoice-test speaks after apply.

workflows.title: TTS: eSpeak NG
workflows.summary: Small CPU synthesizer. Always runs. Lowest quality of the TTS options.
workflows.notes: Floor TTS. Use when you want guaranteed speech with no models.

workflows.title: STT: whisper.cpp
workflows.summary: Local speech-to-text. Uses the ggml Vulkan backend when a GPU is present.
workflows.notes: Installs whisper-cli from Ubuntu and fetches ggml-base.en.bin into ~/Models/whisper if no whisper model is found.

workflows.title: Image helpers
workflows.summary: ffmpeg and ImageMagick plus shared model folders. Does not install ComfyUI.
workflows.notes: If a ComfyUI checkout is found, extra_model_paths.yaml is written only when that file is missing.

workflows.title: Video helpers
workflows.summary: ffmpeg with the GPU encoder this machine can use. Does not install a video app or download video weights.
workflows.notes: Does not download Wan or Hunyuan weights.

workflows.title: Document helpers
workflows.summary: pandoc, OCR, and PDF tools for local documents. Does not install a retrieval server.

workflows.title: Editor helpers
workflows.summary: ripgrep and a localhost URL for an editor agent. Does not install VS Code or an agent.
workflows.notes: Writes the localhost base URL into config.

workflows.title: Serve
workflows.summary: GPU serving stack. Apply installs ROCm or CUDA from Ubuntu when an AMD or NVIDIA GPU is present.
workflows.notes: Grey out only when there is no AMD or NVIDIA GPU. Missing rocminfo or nvidia-smi is an apt job. Does not pip-install vLLM or PyTorch.

workflows.title: Train
workflows.summary: CUDA or ROCm from Ubuntu plus an isolated venv. Opt-in and large.
workflows.notes: Does not pip-install PyTorch. Prepares the isolated venv directory and the archive GPU stack.
